Kubernetes API client

Source: R/client.R
ApiClient.Rd

Kubernetes API client

Kubernetes API client

Details

Low-level transport used by every generated API class. Wraps httr2::request() with authentication, TLS, serialization, and error translation. You rarely call call_api() directly; instead, you pass an ApiClient into a typed API class like CoreV1Api or AppsV1Api, or a DynamicClient.

Mirrors kubernetes.client.ApiClient from the Python client and rest.RESTClient from client-go.

Public fields

configuration

The attached Configuration.

default_headers

Named list of headers added to every request.

Method new()

Construct an ApiClient.

Usage

ApiClient$new(configuration = Configuration$new(), default_headers = list())

Arguments

configuration

A Configuration (defaults to an empty one).

default_headers

Additional headers, as a named list.

Method call_api()

Perform an HTTP call against the API server.

Usage

ApiClient$call_api(
  resource_path,
  method = "GET",
  path_params = list(),
  query_params = list(),
  header_params = list(),
  body = NULL,
  response_type = NULL,
  content_type = "application/json",
  accept = "application/json",
  stream = FALSE
)

Arguments

resource_path

Path portion of the URL (e.g. "/api/v1/namespaces/{namespace}/pods").

method

HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE).

path_params

Named list of path params substituted into resource_path.

query_params

Named list of query parameters.

header_params

Named list of headers (merged with defaults).

body

An R object (serialized as JSON) or a raw/character body.

response_type

Either NULL (return parsed JSON as a nested list), "raw" (return raw bytes), "text" (return string), or the name of a generated model class (return an instance, constructed via $from_list).

content_type

Content-Type to send (default application/json; use application/merge-patch+json, application/strategic-merge-patch+json, or application/json-patch+json for PATCH variants).

accept

Accept header (default application/json).

stream

If TRUE, return the raw httr2::response without reading the body - used by Watch and log-streaming.

Method select_path()

Substitute {name} placeholders in a path template.

Usage

ApiClient$select_path(path_template, path_params = list())

Arguments

path_template

E.g. "/api/v1/namespaces/{namespace}/pods/{name}".

path_params

Named list of replacements.

Method clone()

The objects of this class are cloneable with this method.

Usage

ApiClient$clone(deep = FALSE)

Arguments

deep

Whether to make a deep clone.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
client <- new_client_from_config()
core   <- CoreV1Api$new(client)
core$list_pod_for_all_namespaces()
} # }
